- **`userinfo`** — Not used: autogroup:// carries everything in the query.

- **`include`** (mobile) — Regex that selects members by tag.
  - Type: string · Default: `""`
- **`exclude`** (mobile) — Regex that subtracts members from the pool.

## Replacements

**Structural translations.** Decisions taken while the link is being read, before any value is judged: whether a block exists at all, where a field comes from, or how one input becomes several fields. The sanitizer sees a finished body and cannot take them.

- `a member tag that resolves to nothing (a nested group, a service type, a dropped node, a foreign tag)` → `the member is left out of the group` — A group lists members by tag; a tag that names nothing is simply not emitted.
  - Kind: `drop`
- `every member of the group dropped out` → `the group is not emitted at all` — An empty urltest block stops the core from starting, so an emptied group is removed rather than written out empty.
  - Kind: `drop`
- `the same member tag listed more than once` → `one entry, first occurrence wins` — Duplicate tags in a group collapse to a single member.
  - Kind: `drop`
- several `balancers[]` in an Xray config → `the first balancer becomes the group; the rest are ignored` — A node group has one membership list, so only the first Xray balancer is converted.
  - Kind: `drop`
